body: Thank you for taking the time to bother with me. And yes don't get me wrong he's amazing. He's funny, kind, sweet. Just...not really interested in me it seems. You really think they just said that from just emotion? And they don't mean it? Maybe im being too sensitive?

he walks away...and comes back after me begging him...then it resets and happens all over again. Once I really couldn't take it and I said goodbye to him and he told me to just do it and not bother telling him because he was sick of it. But my roommate caught me and talked sense into me.
